description: Call this before recommending, buying or selling anything used or secondhand, any baby or kids' product, appliance, heater, battery-powered device or vehicle, or when the person asks if something is safe or recalled. Searches US government recall notices: CPSC for consumer products (appliances, furniture, kids' products, electronics, tools; by brand and model or UPC) and NHTSA for vehicles (by year, make and model). Use before buying, selling or recommending something, especially used or secondhand. Returns decision (recalled / possible_recall / no_recall_found / insufficient_evidence) with each notice's hazard, remedy, which units it applies to and the official link. 'no_recall_found' is not a safety guarantee.

brand.description: Optional: the brand, if not in product.

model.description: Optional: the exact model number, if not in product.

product.description: Brand and model as on the label or listing, e.g. 'Graco SnugRide 35', 'Ninja AF101', 'Arlopu KT-CS17 slide playset'. Model numbers matter: send them when you have them.

vehicle.description: For cars and motorcycles: year, make and model, e.g. '2023 Tesla Model Y'. Or send make, model and year separately.

name: check_recalls
title: Check for recalls
